name: cloudstorage-onedrive
description: Read personal OneDrive through the CloudStorage Portal hosted Microsoft Graph MCP with a separate delegated OAuth grant.

interface.longDescription: Connect a personal Microsoft OneDrive account through a dedicated CloudStorage Portal OAuth client and perform bounded, read-only account, root, folder and text-file operations. Local OneDrive sync folders remain separate from Microsoft Graph access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Vis min verificerede OneDrive-konto og indholdet i roden uden at ændre filer.
